frozen_test_range_carried_forward.scope: small controlled test range; not exhaustive

pre_specified: eight histories, four probe configurations, three conditions, ten seeds, frozen physics and PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL rule
performance is mu_true; observed reward drives inference only
controlled contrasts are questions rather than predictions
observed: Campaign 1 passed its frozen range-characterisation rule
mean FULL cumulative performance by scenario: TR-PR 29.996, TR-PM 27.834, TR-G 26.676, TR-J 26.377, TR-R 29.264, TR-D 26.124, TR-HA 26.671, TR-HB 26.504
FULL minus NO-DEVELOP is positive in all 32 scenario x configuration means
FULL and KNOWN-Z coincide for G04/G07 in TR-PR, TR-PM and TR-R
mechanistic_interpretation: within the retained trajectories, problem history changes belief/decision, assignment, continuous exposure, capability state, later decision and performance
these comparisons are diagnostic system-level consequences, not an additive causal decomposition of DISCOVER and DEVELOP
negative_null: G07 is the mean cumulative FULL leader in all eight scenarios; no diversity of cumulative-performance winners was observed
no development liability was observed under FULL versus NO-DEVELOP
TR-G/TR-J and TR-HA/TR-HB have near-null FULL cumulative responses for G04/G07
a divergent intermediate trajectory can reconverge to equal final-A action and performance (G07 seed 0 TR-G/TR-J)
limitations_and_unsupported: not evidence of universal heterogeneous-team superiority or a generally optimal G07 geometry
TR-PR/TR-PM does not isolate representational mismatch because true production problem also changes
TR-R/TR-D does not isolate recurrence because it is not matched in content or total change
FULL minus KNOWN-Z is not a pure additive cost of DISCOVER
no universal causal relation between C, N or M and performance is established
no generalization beyond the frozen CES/Bayes/MPC/MIS-v2 laboratory is established
Campaign 1 compares no alternative adaptive strategies
